title: Tipping App
summary: A Progressive Web App for QR-based wallet-to-wallet tipping, designed to let customers tip without installing a native application.
result: Release time reduced from hours to under 15 minutes
challenge: The tipping experience needed to work quickly on mobile devices without requiring customers to install a native application.
solution: Built a Progressive Web App for QR-based wallet-to-wallet tipping.
Implemented the frontend and backend transaction workflow.
Optimized the deployment process with Linux and CI/CD tooling.
Designed the experience around quick access from QR codes.
outcomes: Customers can tip without installing a native application.
Release time was reduced from hours to under 15 minutes.
